acceptanceMatrix.item: Custom Vazhipadu option appears only under വഴിപാട്
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: appendCustomVazhipaduOption checks cat === 'വഴിപാട്'. Directly verified by TC-01, TC-01-CHIP, TC-02, TC-02-CHIP.

acceptanceMatrix.item: BILLING_DEFAULT_ITEMS remains unchanged at 13 items
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: BILLING_DEFAULT_ITEMS array length for category വഴിപാട് is 13. Directly verified by TC-03-A, TC-03-B, and test_step_33_34a.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Custom item name accepts 2–80 characters and rejects blank or generic placeholder names
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: billingSubmitForm validates trimmed length 2-80, rejects empty, 'Custom', 'Custom Vazhipadu', 'കസ്റ്റം വഴിപാട്'. Verified by TC-09-A, TC-09-B, TC-09-C.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Rate must be greater than zero and no more than ₹100,000
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: billingSubmitForm validates rate > 0 and rate <= 100000. Verified by TC-09-D, TC-09-E, TC-09-F, TC-11.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Rate rounding uses two decimal places
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: Math.round(rate * 100) / 100 enforced in updatePrice and billingSubmitForm. Verified by TC-07, TC-08.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Quantity must be an integer between 1 and 500
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: Number.isInteger check with 1-500 bounds enforced. Verified by TC-10-A, TC-10-B, TC-10-C.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Switching category or item clears stale custom values
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: loadCategoryItems and updatePrice clear custom inputs and hide row. Verified by TC-05, TC-05-CLEARED, TC-06.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Total equals the validated unit rate multiplied by quantity
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: Reactive calculation lineTotal = validatedRate * qty. Verified by TC-07, TC-08.

acceptanceMatrix.item: The actual custom puja name is stored as the item description
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: billing document stores custom item string in 'item' field. Verified by TC-12.

acceptanceMatrix.item: The bill stores custom-item marker, item name, unit price, and total
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: billing document stores isCustomItem: true, item, unitPrice, totalAmount. Verified by TC-12, TC-20-A.

acceptanceMatrix.item: The linked accounting receipt uses actual puja name and correct quantity
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: receipts document description contains '${item} (Qty: ${qty}) | Star: ${star}'. Verified by TC-13, TC-13-DESC.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Mapping remains General Temple Fund plus Vazhipadu Income
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: receipt fund is 'General Temple Fund', category is 'Vazhipadu Income'. Verified by TC-13-CLASS.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Dashboard, Receipts, Cash Book, Bank Book derive income from authoritative receipts flow
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: allReceipts(), buildCashBookRows(), buildBankBookRows() query active receipts exclusively. Verified by TC-17-A..C, TC-18-A..C.

acceptanceMatrix.item: The linked bill and receipt are not counted twice
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: billing collection produces ₹0.00 financial ledger contribution; receipts contributes exact ₹750.00. Verified by TC-17-D.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Voiding follows existing linked-record and audit-trail behavior
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: Atomic transaction marks bill, receipt, res as voided: true with voidReason preserved. Verified by TC-23-A..D.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Thermal receipt prints actual puja name, quantity, and rate
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: formatThermalReceiptHtml renders custom puja name in bold, unit price, qty, and total. Verified by TC-14-A..C.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Billing history, search, and reprint retain custom item description
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: History table, text search filtering, and reprint modal preserve custom details. Verified by TC-15, TC-16.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Billing reports and CSV exports retain item, rate, quantity, and total
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: CSV export row and item summary map retain custom name, rate, qty, and total. Verified by TC-19-A..D.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Backup/restore preserves custom-item fields
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: _serializeDoc preserves custom fields; isValidMonetary validates rates. Verified by TC-20-A, TC-20-B.

acceptanceMatrix.item: Global numbering and idempotency behavior remain unchanged
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: Monotonic sequential sequence allocation and financial fingerprint replay protection verified by TC-21-A, TC-21-B, TC-22.

acceptanceMatrix.item: No historical records are rewritten or renumbered
acceptanceMatrix.evidence: fsCreateBillingWithAccounting appends new records at head of monotonic counter; no migration or renumbering logic touches existing documents.

countingConvention.explanation: The 672 total checks represents the mathematical sum of all checks evaluated across the 15 regression test suites. The 3 skipped checks in test_step_33_12 (NT-01, NT-02, NT-03) represent external technical constraints (physical printer hardware absent, production Firestore mutation lockout, production rules CLI deployment lockout) and are explicitly excluded from the 43 executed checks of that suite (which has 43 evaluated, 43 passed). double-counting is avoided by tracking the 3 skipped checks as a separate metadata attribute.
countingConvention.historical25CheckDiscrepancyResolved: The 25-check discrepancy in STEP 33.56B (reported 647 vs sum 672) occurred because the author inherited a manual footer formula from STEP 33.55 that inadvertently omitted the 25 passed checks of tests/test_step_33_54_cleanup_audit.js. In this reconciliation, Suite #7 (test_step_33_54) is explicitly included with 25 passed checks.
